texts.preamble: Kuttuboina Vara Prasad, vs State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 23 November, 2020 Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy Criminal Petition No.5333 Of 2020 Order:
texts.arguments: 2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor. 3. The petitioner is the sole accused in C.C.No.116 of 2018 on the file of the learned II Addl. Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District. He has been facing prosecution for the offences punishable under Section 353 IPC and under Section 58 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short "FSS Act"). 4. At the time of hearing of this petition, learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that this is a covered matter and this Court has earlier in Criminal Petition No.1432 of 2020 and batch as per common order passed in the said petitions, [LEAKAGE_MASK] the F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts. Therefore, he would submit that the petitioner herein is also similarly placed and he is also entitled for quash of criminal proceedings initiated against him.
